articleTitle: Research and Application of an Automatic Test Sequence Generation Method Based on a Virtual Track Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's railway system, track scenarios are becoming increasingly complex, characterized by a wide variety of engineering data tables and strong data coupling among them. The manual creation of test sequences is labor-intensive and computationally demanding, making the automatic generation of test sequences a topic of significant research interest. This paper proposes an automatic test sequence generation method based on a virtual track coordinate system. The method includes the construction of the virtual track coordinate system, which is based on track direction, chainage interruption information, and mileage system transformation relationships, as well as a mapping method between the kilometer marker system and configuration attribute sets within the virtual track coordinate system. The method is validated using real-world engineering data under complex track scenarios, focusing on track conditions and RBC handovers. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can automatically generate test sequences and verify their correctness. Compared to manual test sequence creation and other automatic generation methods, the virtual track coordinate system-based approach is better suited to complex track scenarios and the coupling of diverse test sequences. Furthermore, the method of establishing the virtual track coordinate system can be applied to other coordinate system modeling needs involving complex mileage systems and chainage interruptions, offering high reusability. Therefore, this method enhances the automation level of data testing in train control systems.

articleTitle: The Impact of Beidou Signal Digital Distortion and Receiver Parameters on Positioning Accuracy for Aviation Differential Users
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The Beidou Navigation Satellite System (BDS) has seen increasingly widespread applications in the aviation sector, but signal distortion has significantly impacted the positioning accuracy of differential aviation users. This paper thoroughly investigates the mechanisms of digital distortion in BDS signals, focusing on the effects of correlator spacing in receivers on ranging and positioning errors. By constructing a pseudorange differential correction model and conducting extensive simulation analyses, the results indicate that under severe digital distortion, ranging errors can reach up to 4.82 meters, while under poor satellite geometry, differential positioning errors can increase to 28.92 meters. The study also indicates that optimizing receiver parameters, such as correlator spacing, especially ensuring consistency between the reference and user receivers, is crucial in minimizing positioning errors. This paper provides theoretical support for the reliable application of the BDS system in aviation differential positioning and offers specific suggestions for optimizing receiver parameters.

articleTitle: A parallel color image encryption algorithm using chaos for colour image encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the advancement of social media, we create and share massive images daily. Inevitably, lots of images are privacy-sensitive, which are supposed to be shared with a set of targeted receivers only. Image encryption can protect image from being accessed in public, but improving its efficiency is a major challenge. Our work extends this line of research by reducing time of encrypting an RGB image. We take the property of RGB images into account and later propose a new scheme that specifies three channels of red, green, and blue. For a particular encryption scheme, we pick chaotic encryption as our instantiation for providing a lightweight, secure, and practical protection. Our idea is to use a parallel encrypting manner regarding to the three channels, thus reducing the encryption time largely. Specifically, pixels in each channel are processed individually, except for a desirable synchronization between permutation and diffusion. At last, we not only carry out security analyses but also benchmark our performance against counterparts. Both experimental results and analytics confirm the practicality and efficiency of our work.

articleTitle: Pneumonia infection segmentation using semi-supervised learning and uncertainty estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of pneumonia lesions is critical for early diagnosis and clinical treatment, while traditional supervised learning methods depend on a substantial amount of labeled data, which are costly to acquire. To address the above issues, this work guides segmentation network training based on semi-supervised learning using an uncertainty estimation that makes full use of unlabeled data to simultaneously extract CNN features from input 3D images at multiple dimensional scales, as well as the use of consistency loss to constrain the consistency of multiscale predictions within and across models. Furthermore, in order to enhance the dependability of model predictions for unlabeled data, the segmentation training was guided by constructing an anatomically aware and multiple dimensional-attention (AA-MDA) network and calculating an uncertainty map. First, unreliable segmentation predictions are fed into an AA-MDA network that has been pre-trained and has an anatomically-aware prior, which subsequently adapts the unreliable predictions to reasonable segmentations through pre-learned representations, and semi-supervised training is guided by comparing the difference between the actual segmentation result and the reasonable segmentation as an uncertainty estimate. Ultimately, the segmentation network achieved high accuracy on the MosMedData dataset.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Semantic Communication System with Multiplicative Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Due to the increasing demand for communication resources in future application scenarios, traditional communication methods may fall short of meeting these requirements. As a result, an increasing number of researchers are focusing on semantic communication. Unlike traditional communication, which focuses solely on data, semantic communication emphasizes the semantics being transmitted, enabling high-quality transmission of compressed data. This article proposes a novel multimodal semantic communication model that employs multiplicative combination for fusing data from different modalities. Multiplicative combination assigns varying weights to different modalities, helping to improve transmission robustness in low SNR environments. We conducted simulation experiments for image and text reconstruction tasks, and the results demonstrate that our model outperforms traditional methods, particularly in low SNR scenarios. This is primarily due to the effective reduction of noise interference through the fusion of different modalities in Diversified Combination.

articleTitle: Design of E-band SIW Bandpass Filter Based on High Sub-mode
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, an E-band substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filter based on TE102 and TE201 modes is designed. The filter introduces one or more transmission zeros by introducing high secondary modes, which can couple with low frequency modes in the resonant cavity. Compared to moment conventional linear SIW filters, the filter's out-of-band rejection performance is improved, which is more conducive to the miniaturization of the component design. The filter has a passband range of 81-86 GHz.With an in-band insertion loss of less than 2.6 dB, an in-band return loss of more than 16 dB, an out-of-band rejection of less than 23 dB in the 70-78 GHz band, and a blocking-band rejection of 25 dB at 88-100 GHz.The filter proposed in this paper has the advantages of miniaturization, high integration and high selectivity.

articleTitle: Lightweight key generation circuits for CRYSTALS-Kyber
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The rapid development of quantum computers poses a significant threat to traditional cryptographic algorithms, rendering them unable to ensure information security. CRYSTALS-Kyber was the only public-key encryption algorithm standardized in 2022. The article designs a lightweight, configurable, and compact key generator for CRYSTALS-Kyber, aimed at resource-constrained IoT devices. The key generator utilizes time-multiplexing of the hash module to sequentially provide hash data to the matrix generation module and the polynomial generation module, thereby generating the required matrix and polynomial data. A configurable binomial distribution sampling module is designed to reduce resource and cycle consumption. The key generator architecture is deployed on the Xilinx Artix-7 platform using the xc7a200tfbg484-3 development board, achieving a frequency of up to 208 MHz while using only 4.8k LUTs, 4.2k FFs, 2 DSPs, and 2.5 BRAMs.

articleTitle: A Personalized Feature Extraction Method for Hand Gesture Classification of sEMG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To realize artificial limb control, it is an important method to use surface electromyography (sEMG) signals to recognize gestures. The sEMG signals are electromyographic signals collected from the surface layer of the skin, which can reflect the neuromuscular activities to a certain extent. Due to its random and non-smooth characteristics, the use of sEMG signals to control artificial intelligent prosthetic limbs has never been able to achieve the desired results, especially reflected in the influence of individual differences such as gender. In this paper, an energy-based gesture recognition method for surface EMG signals is proposed and validated on the Ninapro dataset through gender difference analysis. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the method is significantly improved in all four classifiers, with an accuracy of 97.06%. Compared with other methods, the classification accuracy is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of FPGA-Based Spread Spectrum Communication Pulse Shaping
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Spread spectrum communication is widely used in hydroacoustic communication. This paper proposes a new method of modulation by splicing based on FPGA for BPSK direct sequence spread spectrum. This method intercepts and saves 8 kinds of code element waveforms, and selects and splices the 8 kinds of code element waveforms for different gold sequences to complete the modulation of the signal, which improves the generating efficiency of BPSK modulated signal and reduces the occupancy of FPGA resources. In this paper, the feasibility of this method is firstly verified by MATLAB simulation, and then implemented based on FPGA. The simulation and shallow sea test results prove the good performance of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Threshold Denoising in LIBS Spectral Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: LIBS technology is subject to significant noise interference when obtaining sample spectra due to the influence of external environment and equipment itself. To achieve better denoising effect, this article improves the threshold function based on a detailed analysis of wavelet threshold denoising, and proves its correctness. Solved the problem of defects in denoising between hard threshold functions and soft threshold functions. Finally, denoising was applied in coal spectra, and simulation consequences showed that the improved denoising method had better denoising effect.

articleTitle: Sparse ISAR Imaging via DM-2D-ADMM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Conventional compressed sensing (CS) inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging algorithms convert the ISAR 2D raw echo data and imaging scene into 1D data for processing, or introduce the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) for sparse signal recovery. The traditional 1D algorithm is relatively complex, and the proposed 2D -ADMM algorithm significantly reduces the complexity, so a 2D-ADMM algorithm under momentum acceleration is proposed based on the existing 2D-ADMM algorithms by considering the phase error. In complex scenarios, the algorithm has faster convergence speed and higher performance than 2D-ADMM and 2D-SL0 algorithms. The superiority of the algorithm is demonstrated based on simulation data and measured data.

articleTitle: Research on lightning effect test methods and key technologies of intelligent and connected vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of intelligent and connected vehicles, the electronic and electrical components related to perception, communication and control carried by vehicles have also surged, and once they are affected by strong electromagnetic interference, it is easy to affect driving safety. In addition to the traditional narrow-band radiated electromagnetic interference, conduction and electrical transient interference caused by coupling, the lightning effect poses a great threat to vehicle safety. At present, there is no test specification for the direct and indirect effects of automotive lightning in the industry, and there is no unified test items, test methods and evaluation system for automotive lightning effect. In this paper, the impact of lightning effect on automobiles is analyzed through theoretical analysis, standard comparison, experimental verification, etc., and the standard conditions of lightning effect in the fields of electric power, communication, and aviation are studied, and the evaluation method of automobile lightning effect is proposed. The research in this paper is helpful to build a more complete technical standard system for automotive electromagnetic compatibility evaluation, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of intelligent and connected vehicles and flying cars.

articleTitle: Parameter Tuning of PID Control for Speed Regulation of a PMSM Using Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm (AHA)
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article focuses on selecting the best gains for PID controllers used in speed control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM). The Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm (AHA), a bio-inspired optimization method, is utilized in this study. The study shows the benefits of using AHA to improve the performance of PMSM.

articleTitle: Material Consumption Prediction of Modern Intelligent Supply Chain for Electric Grid Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Predicting material consumption in modern intelligent supply chains for electric grids is crucial for optimizing inventory management and ensuring efficient operations. Traditional forecasting methods often struggle with the complexity and non-linearity of supply chain dynamics, especially in the context of rapidly evolving technologies and fluctuating demand patterns. This paper proposes a novel approach utilizing deep learning techniques to forecast material consumption accurately. First, the material programme management framework is analysed. Then, a networked warehousing system is constructed to storage and dispatch materials. In addition, an efficient material inventory management approach is proposed. Next, based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network in deep learning technology, a material consumption prediction model is built to accurately predict material consumption, which helps for the modern intelligent supply chain construction of electric grid businesses. Finally, some practical examples exhibit that the established material consumption prediction model can accurately predict material consumption. This research underscore the potential of deep learning in revolutionizing supply chain management for electric grids, paving the way for more resilient and sustainable energy infrastructures.

articleTitle: A novel real-time arcing detection model of pantograph-catenary for high-speed train
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The arcing happened in Pantograph-catenary system could damage railway operation. Arcing are characterized by short and volatile durations, making it challenging to rapidly detect and segment arcing of varying shapes and sizes. To address these issues, a fast deep learning based semantic segmentation model named ECA-ArcSC is proposed for real-time arcing detecting and segmentation task. Firstly, four downsampling convolution layers are utilized to capture spatial information of the arcing. Concurrently, a four-stage downsampling strategy is employed to calculate contextual information of the arcing. Finally, the spatial and contextual information of the arcing is aggregated to predict the final dense semantic segmentation output. Experimental results on the Pantograph-catenary arcing dataset and comparative analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving IoU of 76.08% and Recall of 84.3%. For inputs of size 512×512, ECA-ArcSC achieves FPS of 123 on an NVIDIA 4070Ti graphics card.

articleTitle: Biped robot control based on adaptive incremental MPC
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of walking control of biped robot based on adaptive incremental MPC(Adaptive IMPC) is implemented. The linear inverted pendulum model(LIPM) is used to simplify the robot into a center of mass moving on a horizontal line and a retractable leg, which is used to establish the dynamic equation and generate a stable walking trajectory. An adaptive incremental model predictive control algorithm is used to track the desired Zero Moment Point (ZMP) trajectory. Compared with the traditional MPC algorithm, its dynamic model adjustment ability and adaptability to nonlinear and time-varying systems have significant advantages in controlling the robot's centroid trajectory and ZMP. Then the motion path of the robot foot is dynamically planned by seventh-degree polynomial interpolation. The trajectory of the center of mass and the trajectory of the robot foot are analyzed, and the inverse kinematics is solved to get the final realization of the joint Angle. Finally, a complete physical simulation is carried out on matlab, and the experimental results show that the above scheme can improve the stability of the biped robot in walking.

articleTitle: Application of the OpenConfg YANG model in the native network automation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article starts from the perspective of operators, analyzes the many difficulties faced by traditional technologies in the process of data center network management, and points out that data model-driven management is the preferred paradigm for solving large-scale cross-platform network operation and maintenance challenges. Furthermore, it proposes a method for constructing a unified data model-driven native network automation operation and maintenance technology architecture based on the OpenConfig YANG model, and practices this method in a simulated network environment through Go language programming. Thus, a more automated and intelligent closed-loop network operation and maintenance concept centered on the operator's intention can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Highly Integrated High Voltage Gate Driver IC with Bootstrap Diode Emulator
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper presents a highly integrated high voltage gate driver integrated circuit (IC), which designed specifically for motor drives. The gate driver IC integrates the high voltage circuit and the low voltage circuit into one chip. It also integrates undervoltage protection, overcurrent protection, and error logic control to improve the reliability. In addition, the gate driver IC using an improved bootstrap diode emulator to implementing the integrated bootstrap function. Instead of an external discrete diode, an improved bootstrap diode emulator is implemented by high voltage laterally diffused metal oxide semiconductor (LDMOS). The gate driver IC is successfully implemented using a 1λm Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD) process and its excellent performance characteristics are verified by experimental results. The experimental results indicate that the improved bootstrap diode emulator saves the circuit area and improves the system reliability compared with the traditional external bootstrap circuit.

articleTitle: Research on Standard HTTP Interface Data Aggregation Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This work elaborates on the design and implementation of a data middle platform capable of flexible data collection from standard HTTP interfaces. It includes the technical implementation plan of the system, the design of the system’s data structure, as well as the analysis of applicable scenarios and application methods. Currently, this system has been put into use as a subsystem of the China Mobile Smart Campus Big Data Platform, playing a key role in multiple critical projects and supporting the data aggregation and data governance work of the big data platform.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Positioning Method for Electrical Impedance Tomography Based on Kalman Filter and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, a combined approach of Kalman Filter and Convolutional Neural Network was adopted. Firstly, the measured voltage signal is denoised to obtain a more stable signal waveform. The denoised and original signals were then used for classification processing, respectively, to study the measurement accuracy of the EIT technique in three-dimensional space and the improvement in accuracy after the denoising process. Two different experiments were designed to investigate the impact of different variables (including the size, shape, and moving distance of the measured object) on the final measurement result. The final conclusion is that the best spatial measurement results can be obtained for a measured object of 3 cm in size and a moving distance of 1.5 cm.

articleTitle: A high-order temperature-compensated bandgap reference without operational amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a new op-amp-free BJT reference voltage source based on high-order compensation using subthreshold MOSFETs. The circuit is implemented using the DB-HITEC 0.18μm BCD process and generates a stable 1.25V output voltage with a 2.5V supply voltage. Over a temperature range of -40 to 125°C, the minimum temperature coefficient is 2.48×10⁻⁶/°C, the maximum temperature coefficient is 3.7×10⁻⁶/°C, the output voltage deviation is 0.5mV, and the power supply rejection ratio is 75dB.Due to its low temperature coefficient (T.C.) and high power supply rejection ratio, the circuit proposed in this paper will be very useful for sensor circuits with stringent requirements or other analog circuits that demand high precision applications.

articleTitle: Radar Signal Sorting Methods Based on Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: As radar technology advances towards lower detectability, the pulse repetition interval (PRI) of radar signals is evolving from traditional simple patterns to large-scale random jitter forms, posing challenges to electronic reconnaissance. True random jitter PRI is difficult to achieve in practice, so a common approach is to use pseudorandom sequences to modulate fixed PRIs, generating pseudorandom jitter PRIs. Traditional radar signal sorting algorithms perform poorly with pulse sequences exhibiting wide-range PRI jitter. Given the periodic nature of pseudorandom sequences, this paper proposes a radar signal sorting algorithm based on correlation analysis to improve the sorting accuracy of pseudorandom jitter PRI sequences. Finally, extensive experiments on pseudorandom jitter PRI sequence sorting validate the proposed method’s superiority over classical methods.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Model for IoT Traffic Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the rapid proliferation of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) devices, the increasingly diverse and complex network traffic presents significant challenges for intrusion detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a deep learning model that integrates Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM), and an attention mechanism. TCN excels at capturing long-term dependencies in data, BiLSTM enhances the model's understanding of sequential information, and the attention mechanism focuses on extracting and weighting key features, significantly improving detection accuracy. We conducted multiclass classification experiments on the Edge-IIoTset dataset, evaluating the model's performance using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model exhibits outstanding performance in IIoT traffic intrusion detection tasks.

articleTitle: A CNN-Aided Post-Processing Scheme for Channel Decoding Under Correlated Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, a convolutional neural network-aided post-processing scheme (CNNAPS) is proposed for improving the channel decoding performance of the denoiser under correlated noise. In this scheme, the CNN estimates actual channel noise for computing the error pattern, and then error nodes are identified by a threshold discrimination method. Specifically, the channel log-likelihood ratio (LLR) value of the identified error node is set to zero, while the received signal of the identified correct node is denoised. Furthermore, one of the key dvantages of CNNAPS is that it does not require knowledge of code structure properties, making it applicable to all linear block codes. Simulation results demonstrate that CNNAPS effectively identifies error nodes within error blocks. It is also shown that by implementing the post-processing along with a single redecoding, CNNAPS can significantly improve the error correction performance of the denoiser with minimal increase in complexity.

articleTitle: A wafer level Scale factor identification method for MEMS accelerometer based on electrostatic excitation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To evaluate the fabricated error in the MEMS resonant accelerometer and reduce the test cost, it is necessary to measure the key parameters of the MEMS chips at the wafer level. This paper proposes a method for scale factor identification for batch measurement at the wafer level with electrostatic excitation. An equivalent acceleration is generated by electrostatic force. which is qualified by both excitation voltage and comb drive actuators. By measuring the frequency response of differential resonators, the scale factor is established. The realization of measurement circuits is described in this paper, and the batch measurements of the scale factor of a wafer are performed. The experimental results show that the measurement error is less than 3%, compared with the scale factor obtained by earth’s gravitational field tumble experiments. The test time for a single chip is 10 s, and the test time for the 6-inch wafer is less than 1.2 hours.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Signal Sorting Method for Laser Warning Based on Skeleton Cycle Traversal
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To enhance the signal sorting capability of laser warning systems in the face of multiple semi-active laser-guided threat sources, this paper first conducts an analysis of multi-target countermeasure requirements. Subsequently, addressing the limitations of existing signal sorting methods in terms of threat laser coding complexity, pulse miss-alarms, and the number of threat lasers, a signal sorting algorithm based on skeleton cycle traversal is proposed. The paper then delves into the principles of this algorithm in detail. Finally, through simulations, it is concluded that the proposed algorithm can sequentially sort out all periodic signals from a mixed signal set, even when the signals exhibit pseudo-random behavior and there are miss-alarms. This demonstrates the algorithm's rationality and feasibility.

articleTitle: A Triple T-coil Based Impedance Matching and Bandwidth Extension Network for High-Speed AFE
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper discusses impedance matching and bandwidth extension techniques in high-speed analog front end (AFE), and proposes a triple T-coil based impedance matching and bandwidth extension network. A differential transmission line and three pairs of differential T-coils are applied in this structure. Post-simulation result demonstrates that the proposed design extends the -3 dB bandwidth by 2.23 times to 47.39 GHz, and the return loss less than -12 dB bandwidth is 47.15 GHz, with the group delay variation range of 1.38 ps.

articleTitle: Low-light Image Enhancement Based on Multi-scale and Mixed Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low brightness, weak contrast, and blurred edges of low illumination images, a multi-scale and mixed loss function based enhancement algorithm (MMLNet) for low illumination images is proposed. Firstly, the input image is decomposed into the illumination and reflectance, and the multi-scale channel and pixel attention module is designed, which is more conducive to the network learning the mapping relationship between low-light image and clear image. Secondly, the brightness enhancement network is used to correct the illumination of the low-light image to improve its brightness. At the same time, the edge extraction network composed of residual structure is designed to extract clear edge information, and the mixed loss function is added to remove a lot of noise. Finally, the final enhancement result is obtained through image reconstruction. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can not only improve the image's visual effect but also PSNR, SSIM and NIQE.

articleTitle: Ship IMO Region Detection Based on The Wavelet Decomposition Optimized CenterNet
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Current research on object detection mainly focuses on objects with specific contour features. However, there is very little research on object detection of ship IMO (International Maritime Organization) regions, which do not have apparent contour features. Object detection of ship IMO regions is an essential primary condition for unmanned aerial vehicles to patrol and monitor designated ships in seaports automatically. Meanwhile, the utilization of the existing object detection framework for ship IMO region detection results in a relatively low average precision. Therefore, we propose a ship IMO region detection method based on wavelet decomposition optimized CenterNet to address the target characteristics of ship IMO regions. The input image is decomposed using wavelet decomposition to obtain several hierarchical target feature information layers. Each layer is weighted and averaged based on its proportion in the original image signal, then combined with the feature layer of the same size in the backbone of CenterNet. The experimental results demonstrate significant performance improvements in mAP, precision, recall, and F1-Score for the wavelet decomposition optimized CenterNet compared to the original CenterNet in ship IMO region detection, with input image sizes of 512×512, 640×640, and 768×768. The code is available at https://github.com/czb7046/CenterNet-Wavelet.

articleTitle: Improved CLAHE Algorithm Based on Independent Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper introduces an advanced image enhancement algorithm that integrates Independent Component Analysis (ICA) with Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to tackle the challenge of feature recognition in images captured by visible light imaging devices. The process begins with converting the image from two dimensions to one. Following this, ICA is applied to decompose the one-dimensional data into a separation matrix and a fusion matrix. An adaptive algorithm then refines the separation coefficients to generate new fusion coefficients, which are used to reconstruct a clearer image. The CLAHE technique is subsequently employed to clip the histogram, preventing overamplification in certain image areas and enhancing both low-and high-contrast regions. The synergy of ICA and CLAHE enhances image quality and detail preservation, leading to more accurate image segmentation and feature extraction.

articleTitle: A multi-mechanism fusion research method for entity relationship extraction modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: NLP relies heavily on entity-relationship extraction, but complicated structures provide challenges for conventional approaches. This paper proposes an advanced model integrating multi-head attention, BiLSTM, CRF, and gated attention mechanisms, leveraging the pre-trained Chinese-RoBERTa-wwm-ext model for text encoding. The Attention-Enhanced BiLSTM captures dependencies and focuses on key information, while CRF optimizes globally. Experiments on the DuIE dataset demonstrate improved efficiency, accuracy, and resilience, offering a robust solution for entity-relationship extraction across various applications.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Modal Inversion—Part III: Designing an Aperture Radiating the Objective Near/Far Field by a Purely Resonant Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: A method for designing an aperture which can radiate the same field as the previously determined objective field on a sampling domain is proposed. The aperture design method can guarantee the aperture-radiated field is purely resonant. The aperture design method is based on the previously proposed energy transport theorem (ETT)-based decoupling mode theory (DMT), energy-based modal decomposition method, and electromagnetic modal inversion method.

articleTitle: A Strong Tracking Unscented Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Addressing the limitations of conventional Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) in terms of a paucity of online adaptive tuning capability, which leads to low accuracy and poor robustness during system state estimation, this paper proposes an enhanced strong tracking UKF algorithm. This innovative approach necessitates only a single unscented transformation, thereby overcoming the computational overhead associated with existing strong tracking UKF algorithms that require two or even three transformations. Furthermore, the positioning and/or derivation of the fading factor in this algorithm differs significantly from other robust tracking UKF implementations. Finally, numerical simulation analysis validates the superior accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved Model-Based Wald Detector for Range-Spread Targets in Heterogeneous Clutter Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Autoregressive (AR) modeling of heterogeneous clutter can improve the probability of detecting range-spread targets, but the detector performance diminishes with fewer pulses due to the loss of samples equivalent to the AR order. To mitigate this performance decline, this paper presents an improved model-based Wald detector for range-spread targets in heterogeneous clutter environments, under the assumption of a known clutter covariance matrix based on the Wald test. Furthermore, the covariance matrix is reconstructed using the lower triangular matrix and real symmetric matrix, both of which are composed of the estimated AR parameters. In addition, considering the varying sea clutter under different sea states and across different range cells, an adaptive detector system consisting of detectors in heterogeneous and homogeneous environments is designed. Based on simulated and real clutter data, we demonstrate that the improved detector outperforms the AR model-based detectors with fewer pulses, and that the adaptive detector system can effectively select the optimal detector for the current clutter environment, ensuring high detection performance.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation from 2D to 3D Based on Complex Valued Frequency Domain Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In recent years, the transform-based approaches have been employed to estimate 3D human pose from 2D keypoint sequences. These approaches learn spatio-temporal correlations by comprehensively taking into account body joints in all frames. Nevertheless, due to the absence of depth information in existing methods, diverse 3D poses might yield the same 2D projection, causing motion ambiguity. To address this issue, we propose a frequency-domain skeletal dynamic modeling methodology. Firstly, the 2D skeleton sequence is transformed to the frequency domain through Fourier transform, and high-frequency noise is eliminated by low-pass filtering to retain the principal motion features. Subsequently, the amplitude and phase information of human bone points is learned by utilizing complex linear layers, and the postures are regenerated and aggregated. Finally, the attitude optimizer is employed to smooth and optimize the attitude, which significantly enhances the stability of the attitude. The aforementioned treatment considerably reduces the impact of motion ambiguity and enhances the accuracy of 3D pose recovery. A considerable number of experimental results demonstrate that the performance of this network architecture on the Human3.6M dataset is improved by 5.3% compared to the previous optimal results.

articleTitle: Parallel optimization design of LDPC decoder with variable normalization factor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor decoding performance of the fixed normalization factor in the normalized minimum sum algorithm, the article proposes a variable normalization factor LDPC decoder, which improves the decoding performance compared to the fixed normalization factor. 0.2dB. At the same time, in order to solve the problems of low throughput and high storage resource usage of some parallel LDPC decoders, the parallelism of the system is increased by adopting the intra-layer parallel structure, and the consumption of storage resources is saved by time-division multiplexing of node data cache units. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional partially parallel structure, the decoder designed in this paper uses 13% more LUT resources, reduces storage resource consumption by 38%, and increases the decoding throughput by 14.5M.

articleTitle: DPT-FCNET: Conformer-based Dual-path Network for Monaural Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Monaural speech enhancement has made extensive progress in the field of amplitude. However, since speech signals in practice are mostly in complex-valued form, it is clearly insufficient to enhance the performance of speech in terms of amplitude characteristics. Recently, T-F dual-path based conformer networks as well as expansion module based encoders and decoders have achieved excellent results in the field of speech enhancement. Therefore, we propose a dual-stream dual-decoding conformer network (DPT-FCNet) based on T-F dual-path for monaural speech enhancement. DPT-FCNet applies the T-F dual-path self-attention mechanism to efficiently model the complex-valued sequences while preserving the phase estimation, and the dual-decoding framework with complex masking and complex spectral mapping provides the model with better learning capability. As a result, DPT-FCNet fully demonstrates the advantages of dual-stream dual-path processing and joint dual-decoding training objectives, and shows advanced performance in VoiceBank+Demand benchmark tests.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Crop Planting Strategy optimization Model Based on PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-stage crop planting strategy optimization model utilizing the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The model aims to address key challenges in agriculture, such as fluctuating market demands, climate variability, and rising production costs. Over a seven-year planning horizon (2024-2030), the model dynamically adjusts crop planting strategies by integrating factors like crop yield, market prices, and crop rotation. The proposed framework optimizes both crop selection and area allocation to maximize economic profitability while maintaining sustainable practices. Unlike traditional static models, this approach accounts for uncertainties and adapts to real-time changes in market conditions. The model's ability to adjust planting strategies based on PSO ensures that farmers can optimize yields and reduce waste through flexible decision-making. Experimental results demonstrate the model's effectiveness in dynamically optimizing planting strategies while satisfying constraints such as land availability and crop rotation.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a TEM Horn Antenna for Urban Underground Space Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Based on transmission line theory, a TEM horn antenna was studied and designed to enhance low-frequency performance. After improvement, it can effectively reduces excessive reflection within the low-frequency band. Additionally, the improvements increase the main axis gain at low-frequency band. Compared to traditional TEM horn antenna, the antenna with incorporated elliptical ridge structure can effectively suppresses back lobe radiation across the entire operating frequency range and broaden the low-frequency bandwidth. Simulation results indicate that the designed antenna operates within a frequency range of 51 to 253 MHz and consistently exceed 2.8 dB in axial gain across this spectrum. With dimensions of 2500 × 1400× 2000 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, the antenna is considered well-suited for the detection of underground spaces at depths reaching up to 30 meters.

articleTitle: Remote sensing image denoising based on Fourier embedding
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aiming to address the issue of limited model expression ability due to the loss of detailed features and insufficient extraction during remote sensing image denoising, this paper proposes a Fourier-embedded remote sensing image denoising network. By analyzing the magnitude spectrum and phase spectrum of Fourier coefficients, it is found that the noise features of the image mainly exist in the phase spectrum. In order to fully utilize this property, Fourier features are learned and their connections are embedded into the detail information recovery block to efficiently capture noise points in the image and recover detail features; local and global contextual semantic information of the image is extracted and integrated from different perceptual dimensions by the multi-scale residual block; and the selective feature fusion block adopts an elemental weighting approach to integrate the feature representations at different levels and selectively highlights useful feature information. In addition, in order to enhance the visual perception of the denoising results, the loss function used to train the model incorporates a combination of perceptual loss, joint mean absolute error, and mean square error. The experimental results show that the proposed model achieves satisfactory results on both synthetic noise data and real noise data.

articleTitle: A Precise Decompression Method for Intel FPGA Bitstream
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: FPAG bitstream is a binary file containing chip configuration information. It is often compressed to conserve storage space and reduce configuration time. In this paper, we propose a precise decompression method for commercial FPGA bitstreams, which is a crucial step for assessing the security of FPGAs. In detail, by comparing the structure of compressed and uncompressed bitstream files, we identify the compression region, extract the compressed data, and construct a database with the mapping information. Then, we introduce a decoding algorithm that utilizes a sliding window approach in terms of the characteristics of the compression data. Finally, our decompression framework is validated on 24 different types of Intel FPGAs from 6 families, with a perfect accuracy rate of 100%.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Text Label Classification for Educational Policy Documents
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This work elaborates on the specific implementation method of the BERT model in completing the classification of policy documents in the China Mobile AI Educational Policy Analysis Platform. By leveraging the open-source pre-trained model in ModelScope, a classification workflow suitable for the task was designed and practically verified in over 20,000 educational documents. This effectively addressed the issue of the complexity of educational policy content and the difficulty in accurate retrieval, achieving excellent results and saving a significant amount of labor in the manual classification of a large number of educational policies.

articleTitle: Reflectionless Q-enhanced Bandpass Filter with Independently Controllable Bandwidth and Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, a fourth-order Q-enhanced bandpass filter (BPF) with independently controllable center frequency and bandwidth is proposed. The center frequency can be programmed within the range of 2.40 to 2.88 GHz, and the bandwidth is adjustable from 2.28 to 9.72 MHz, with a passband ripple of less than 0.2 dB. The positive feedback loop is used to enhance the quality factor (Q) in this BPF, which stably increases the Q of the original resonator from 21 to 2500. The measured results agrees well with the theory. This work demonstrates the feasibility of designing on-chip filters with high frequency selectivity to adapt to multi-band communications.

articleTitle: A Schmidt comparator for single-event_transient protection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The influence of single-event_transient effects on Schmidt comparator under radiation conditions is investigated using a 0.25μm CMOS process. After simulation analysis, it is found that the output node and input reference current node of the Schmidt comparator are sensitive to the single-particle transient effect, and the magnitude of the output driving capability of the bias circuit of the sensitive node affects the ability of the Schmidt comparator to resist the single-event _transient effect. To increase the comparator's resistance to single-particle transients, the comparator's resistance to single-event_transients is increased by adding a compensating current source and increasing the number of parallel tubes.

articleTitle: Visual SLAM in Dynamic Environment Based on ORB-SLAM3
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: At present, the mainstream SLAM system mainly works in the static environment, and there will be a large error in the dynamic environment. This paper presents a VSLAM method for dynamic feature point detection based on target detection algorithm and LK optical flow method. The SLAM system is capable of robust, accurate and continuous operation in highly dynamic environments. The method first obtains the potential dynamic frame by passing the image into the target detection network. Then the matching feature points of two adjacent frames are obtained by optical flow method. In order to accurately remove dynamic feature points, the dynamic frame is first identified by the threshold value of the dynamic frame, and then the dynamic feature points in the dynamic frame are identified according to the threshold value of the dynamic feature points. Finally, the dynamic feature points in the dynamic frame are eliminated. Our proposed algorithm has been tested on TUM dataset for many times, and the performance is significantly improved compared to the original ORB-SLAM3. Compared with the current better methods, this method can significantly improve some indexes.

articleTitle: A Compact Portable Multi-sensor Hydraulic Profiling Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Organic pollutants can spread further through horizontal or downward infiltration, carried by flowing water, and thereby contaminate more areas. The movement of water within the soil is influenced by the soil’s hydraulic conductivity. In this study, we designed a compact portable multi-sensor hydraulic profiling detection system to estimate the soil's hydraulic conductivity. This system is well-suited for mobile applications in complex field environments and provides insight into the vertical variation of hydraulic conductivity in the soil. By doing so, it enables the prediction of pollutant diffusion behavior within the soil, allowing for early intervention and control measures. This proactive approach has significant implications for the prevention and mitigation of soil pollution.

articleTitle: On-chip LDO with high PSRR and wide input range based on FVF architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: A wide-input, simple-structured, fast transient response low dropout (LDO) linear regulator without output capacitor is proposed. A flipped voltage follower (FVF) structure is used to form a fast local loop that drives the power transistor, achieving fast transient response. Additionally, a cascode current mirror structure is inserted into the FVF to achieve a wide input power supply range, making it a high-voltage-tolerant structure. The power supply for the error amplifier (EA) is directly provided by the LDO output, forming a bootstrap power supply. It can operate stably within a load range of 0 to 20mA, with a quiescent current as low as 6μA. This method compensates for the shortcomings of traditional LDOs, such as low integration, large area, high power consumption, and poor transient response. The circuit is fabricated using the CSMC 180 nm process. Simulation results show that the circuit’s dropout voltage is 150 mV, the quiescent current is 6 μA, the input voltage range is 3.5-60V, and the low-frequency power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) is -150dB. When the load current changes between 0 mA and 20 mA, with an edge time of 100 ns and a load capacitance of 120 pF, the maximum overshoot generated is 60 mV, the undershoot is 70 mV, and the transient voltage recovery time is 300 ns.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on TCN-BiGRU-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In response to the complex working environment of rolling bearings and the problem of low fault identification due to noise interference in vibration signals, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on TCN-BiGRU-Attention is proposed. Firstly, VMD decomposes the vibration signal of the rolling bearing to obtain k IMF components; secondly, by evaluating the index, IMF components with rich fault information are selected, and nine features such as mean, variance, peak value, kurtosis, effective value, peak factor, impulse factor, waveform factor, and margin factor are calculated; finally, the features are input into the hybrid neural network model, where TCN is used to extract the spatial features of time series data, BiGRU is used to capture the temporal features, and the attention mechanism is used to enhance the model's ability to identify key features. The method is verified using the rolling bearing vibration signal of Case Western Reserve University in the United States, and the experimental results show that the method can effectively extract fault features and accurately identify the fault state of rolling bearings, showing a high diagnostic accuracy rate and good application potential.

articleTitle: Real-time Fingerprints Embedding Method for Malicious Encrypted Traffic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The traffic encryption technology protects the privacy of network users. Meanwhile, it also provides convenience for illegal cyberspace activities such as malicious attacks. Since no plain-text information exposed, network administrators have no idea whether the network traffic is malicious or where attackers come from. Therefore, encrypted malicious traffic analysis methods are put forward for ensuring the network security. These methods aim at finding out abnormal traffic among received data flows, and even find the source of abnormal traffic in the other end of networks. However, existing methods follow the passive manner which totally depends on traffic’s own features, thus having a poor effectiveness since malicious traffic usually does not reveal too many distinguished features. To solve this problem, we put forward an active analysis method based on the real-time traffic fingerprints embedding, enhancing the capability of encrypted malicious traffic analysis. Firstly, we insert the signal into the traffic toward all suspicious attackers’ side, then detect the embedded traffic from the received data of victims, finally extract the signal from detected samples and compare the signal similarity. Once the similarity meets the standard, we can confirm the end-to-end communication relationships involved in malicious network behaviors. Experiment results show that the active analysis way has obviously better results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management Model for Two-ticket System of Power Grid Enterprise Safety Production by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The smart power grid is crucial for modern energy systems, offering enhanced efficiency, reliability, and sustainability through advanced technologies. The two-ticket operations, i.e., work ticket and operation ticket, ensure safety and stability in grid management. However, traditional methods of managing these tickets face inefficiencies, errors, and safety risks, mainly due to the manual processes. With more complexity of the operations, these challenges still threaten the overall performance. This paper examines the application of big data analytics to optimize the management of grid two-ticket system. By leveraging predictive maintenance, real-time monitoring, and decision-making support, big data analysis can significantly improve the efficiency, safety, and reliability of smart grid operations. The integration of these technologies addresses the limitations of traditional methods and supports the evolution of more resilient and intelligent energy systems.

articleTitle: A Ripple Controller for Single-Inductor Multiple-Output Boost Converters with Non-Cross-Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: single-inductor multiple-output (SIMO) boost converter faces an issuce of mutual interference and cross-regulation among output voltages. This paper proposes a ripple-based non-cross-regulation controller suitable for SIMO boost converters. The proposed ripple controller effectively resolves the problems of mutual interference and cross-regulation between outputs.

articleTitle: A Fast Transient Response Output-capacitorless LDO With Low Quiescent Power
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: An output capacitorless low-dropout regulator (LDO) with a transient enhancement circuit is proposed. The proposed transient enhancement circuit provides a charging and discharging path to the gate of the power transistor during rapid load changes, achieving good transient response without the need for an external output capacitor. The circuit make use of the overshoot or undershoot voltage to temporarily increase the charging or discharging current, thereby enhancing the transient response performance of the LDO. Simulation results show that the proposed LDO consumes a quiescent current of 5μA and operates with an input voltage of 1.8V, regulating output voltage of 1.6V, with dropout voltage of 200mV, and maximum output current of 100mA. When the load current steps from 1mA to 100mA with a load step of 40mA/μs, the undershoot voltage is 70.52mV, with a recovery time of 2.68μs. Conversely, when the load current steps from 100mA to 1mA in the same time frame, the overshoot voltage is 46.48mV, with a recovery time of 6.5μs. Additionally, the LDO achieves stability across the full load range of 0-100mA with an output capacitance of 10pF.

articleTitle: Clock Skew and Offset Estimation Based on Correlation Detection under Unknown Asymmetric Time Delay Conditions in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Accurate clock synchronization is essential to the application of wireless sensor networks, where time delays are unavoidable, and unknown asymmetric time delays will affect the synchronization accuracy. Currently, most researches assume that the uplink and downlink delays are equal or known for the convenience of estimating clock synchronization parameters. However, in practice, uplink and downlink delays are often unknown and asymmetric, significantly reducing estimation accuracy and affecting clock synchronization. To address this challenge, we propose a joint estimation of clock skew and offset method based on correlation detection to achieve clock synchronization under unknown asymmetric time delays. Specifically, we first change the size of transmitted packets to reduce the influence of unknown asymmetric time delays on clock synchronization accuracy. Meanwhile, the whole process is completed at the physical layer, avoiding the impact of random time delays caused by timestamps. Simulation results show that the proposed method has higher estimation accuracy in clock skew and offset than the traditional clock synchronization methods under unknown asymmetric time delays.

articleTitle: Implementation of Rlibm-OMP Algorithm Based on Sunway
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The performance bottleneck of math library functions has long been a common issue among major manufacturers. To overcome these bottlenecks, this paper proposes the Rlibm-OMP method, which combines the RLibm fast polynomial method with the OpenMP parallel programming model based on Sunway architecture. This approach is aimed at generating polynomial replacements for foundational library functions. The RLibm fast polynomial method aims to produce polynomial replacements that yield correct results for foundational functions across all inputs and various rounding modes. However, due to several adaptation issues when porting external platform algorithms to the Sunway platform, performance often degrades. Thus, an optimization was carried out using the OpenMP parallel programming model based on Sunway to optimize polynomial evaluations. By integrating the RLibm fast polynomial method with the OpenMP parallel programming model, it is possible not only to generate correctly rounded polynomials but also to achieve efficient parallel computations on the Sunway platform. Experimental results indicate that the polynomial results for 32-bit floating-point functions are not only accurate but also, on average, 12% faster than those achieved using the Rlibm fast polynomial method alone.

articleTitle: 2 out of N Secret Sharing Scheme Over GF(Qk)
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In 2 out of n secret sharing scheme, a secret is splitted into n shares, and any 2 shares will recover the secret while any single share will leak no information about the secret. Previously the secret is drawn from prime field GF(q), where q is a prime number. In this paper, we realize a 2 out of n secret sharing scheme, where the secret can be drawn from extension field GF(q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>). Previous schemes can be seen as a special case of our scheme, where k=1.

articleTitle: Power 5G Terminal Management Component Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the gradual popularisation of the network, enterprise network construction has become an inevitable choice for enterprise information development. This not only provides a basic operating platform for the modern development and comprehensive information management of enterprises, but also provides a variety of application services and management for 5G terminals. The construction of 5G terminal management engineering for electric power enterprises is an important branch of utilising server deployment. Therefore, this design topic will mainly focus on the various technologies and implementation schemes used in 5G terminal management, providing the theoretical basis and practical guidance for 5G terminal management construction. This paper analyses and describes the research on enterprise server construction, focusing on the construction of the system environment, MySQL database, application software deployment, etc., and provides specific design solutions.

articleTitle: Parameter recommendation system enhanced by RAG based on process knowledge
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article proposes an innovative method that utilizes the Neo4j graph database as a vector database to segment text, images, and table contents in process files and convert them into vector form for storage. On this basis, a parameter recommendation system was designed and implemented. The system efficiently retrieves parameter reference questions raised by users through vector similarity matching technology, and passes the matched relevant results to advanced machine learning models for further analysis. Ultimately, the system is able to accurately answer users' questions and recommend corresponding parameter ranges, significantly improving the efficiency and accuracy of enterprises in obtaining specific parameter requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Qingzhou Tourism Information Service System Based on LBS
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper designs and implements the tourism information service system of Qingzhou City based on LBS, integrating GIS, mobile Internet and big data analysis technology. The system is divided into a presentation layer, a business logic layer, and a data access layer, providing functions such as attraction introduction, real-time navigation, and personalized route planning. The information center module integrates tourism resources in Qingzhou City, and the publishing module provides resource information for managers to publish. The map module provides positioning, navigation, and other services. My module supports users to manage their personal itineraries and preferences. The system has implemented personalized recommendations and social sharing, which can enhance user experience and promote the development of tourism industry in Qingzhou City. The system has a clear structure and comprehensive functions, meeting the needs of intelligent and personalized tourism information services.

articleTitle: Block Clustering Method for Large Scale InSAR Interferometric Phase Diagram based on GSOM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In large-scale complex geographical environments, the interferometric phase diagram regions corresponding to different surface coverage, topography, etc. generally have different phase quality, coherence and signal-to-noise ratio. Segmenting the interferometric phase diagram of interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) in large-scale complex geographical environments into different sub-images and using different unwrapping methods according to their characteristics is an effective way to avoid the noise diffusion of low-quality phase regions and reduce the overall phase unwrapping accuracy. In order to reasonably segment the interferometric phase diagram, this paper proposes a block clustering method based on the growing self-organizing map (GSOM) network. First, the large-scale interferometric phase diagram is evenly divided into several sub-images of the same size. The correlation coefficient, average phase variance, average pixel value and horizontal and vertical coordinates of the center position corresponding for each sub-phase diagram are calculated, and used as the input feature data of the GSOM network. Then, the square Euclidean distance between the input vector and the weight vectors of all self-organizing map (SOM) nodes is used as the distance metric function. The GSOM network with dynamic growth ability is constructed and trained autonomously to obtain the clustering results of all sub-phase diagrams. The final clustering result of each type is taken as an unwrapped sub-region of the large-scale interferometric phase diagram. To illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, SOM network, hierarchical clustering, cuckoo search algorithm are used for comparative experiments with the proposed method, and clustering evaluation indicators are used to evaluate the clustering results. The experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to the above three methods in the clustering of large-scale interferometric phase diagram.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Bracelet Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In order to enhance the ability to monitor human health conditions, we have designed a smart bracelet based on the STM32 core control module. This bracelet is composed of multiple modules, including a human health data monitoring module, GPS module, LCD display module, and wireless communication module. The system first acquires the user's health data such as heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature through the human health monitoring module and processes and analyzes these data. The processed information is displayed in real-time through the LCD display module and simultaneously transmitted to the user's mobile phone via the wireless communication module. Experiments have proven that this smart bracelet can effectively be used for monitoring users' health status.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Local Electronic Chart Updating Based on Perceived Data in Route Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article aims to explore the application research of local electronic chart updates based on perceptual data in route planning. By integrating multi-source perception data of ships, such as radar, GPS, AIS and other equipment information, real-time and local updates of electronic charts can be achieved to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of electronic charts. The research focuses on the fusion and processing of perceptual data, local update algorithms for electronic chart data, and security and reliability guarantees during the update process. This study aims to provide more accurate and real-time navigation information for ships, in order to prevent potential risks during navigation and improve the safety and efficiency of ship navigation [1].

articleTitle: A novel multiple filtering method for UAV vibration signal obtained by using optical fiber sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) are gradually applied in varied fields because of its high efficiency, precision and flexibility. The structural damages of UAV have become a prominent safety issue for ensuring the structural safety. To control the vibration caused safety and economic loss efficiently, vibration detection is of ultimate importance. The recent research in the optical fiber sensor-based new detecting technology has shown the good application potential and unique advantages owing to its high sensitivity. For detecting the UAV vibration signal, we designed a fiber sensor, and built a fiber signal processing system. This paper proposes a novel method for filtering vibration signals obtained by optical fiber grating-based fiber signal sensing, which achieves an excellent singular signal detection ability and resolution capability.

articleTitle: A 0.4-V 13-bit 800-kS/s SAR-ISDM ADC with High-Precision Dual-Bootstrap Switch
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper presents an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) with a resolution of 13 bits and a sampling rate of 800 kS/s. The ADC utilizes a hybrid structure combining successive-approximation register (SAR) ADCs and incremental sigma-delta modulator (ISDM) architectures for the coarse and fine conversion, leveraging the low power consumption of SAR ADCs and the high precision of ISDM. A high-precision dual-bootstrap switch is proposed, which reduces leakage current by achieving a negative gate voltage. This increases the spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR) of the sampled signal by 7.5 dB and improves the effective number of bits (ENOB) by 1.1 bits. An improved merged capacitor switching (MCS) scheme is presented to avoid using additional reference levels. The hybrid ADC is designed in 14-nm CMOS technology. The simulated SFDR and signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) at Nyquist-frequency inputs are 85.52 and 74.54 dB, respectively. The ADC consumes 7.184 μW at 0.4-V supply and 800-kS/s sampling rate. The resultant Walden figure of merit (FoMw) is 2.1 fJ/conversion step.

articleTitle: Interference analysis and suppression of power wireless private network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To ensure the communication performance of the power wireless private network under low-density station construction, this article analyzes the interference problem of the 1800 MHz TD-LTE network in the application of the power industry. The article provides a detailed analysis of the level strength and time period of interference, identifies different types of interference including blocking interference, and proposes corresponding verification methods. Furthermore, based on the interference characteristics, targeted TD-LTE interference remediation strategies were proposed, and the effectiveness of these methods was confirmed through data processing and comparative analysis of actual cases, providing technical support for the widespread application of LTE power wireless private networks.

articleTitle: Attention-enhanced Knowledge-aware Cross Network for Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Knowledge graph-based recommender systems use collaborative filtering data and knowledge graph data to improve prediction accuracy. Aiming at the problem that the knowledge-aware recommendation algorithm cannot fully mine and utilize high-order information, an improved knowledge-aware recommendation algorithm (AKCN) was proposed, which combined the knowledge-aware attention under collaborative guidance to better distinguish the importance between different neighbors, and added a cross-compression unit in the embedding module to make full use of high-order information. Experimental results on book Crossing and Last.-FM datasets show that AKCN achieves a certain performance improvement compared with CKAN and KGAT.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Driving Scenario and Decision-making based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The foundation of autonomous driving safety is high-precision environmental perception. As a mission-critical task, object detection has attracted considerable attention in recent years. It employs a range of sensors to gather data on factors such as target position, size, and direction of movement, thereby providing a crucial foundation for driving decisions. This study employs an enhanced Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to investigate decision-making processes in autonomous driving scenarios, thereby advancing the field of artificial intelligence. The introduction of a multi-scale feature extraction module and a self-attention mechanism serves to enhance the model's capacity for perception of complex traffic environments and recognition of key scenes. The model is capable of efficiently processing sensor data, thereby facilitating accurate scene understanding and real-time decision optimisation. The experimental analysis demonstrates that the enhanced model exhibits superior performance compared to the conventional approach across a spectrum of driving scenarios, thereby enhancing the precision and dependability of decision-making.

articleTitle: Line Spectrum Detection Technology Based on Long-Term Coherent Accumulation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The long-time coherent accumulation algorithm is commonly employed in passive sonar for enhancing signal-to-noise ratio in line spectrum detection. When there is relative motion between the target and the receiver, doppler frequency shift broadens the received line spectrum signal. In this study, the received signal is simulated using the bellhop procedure, ensuring channel coherence. Through the long-time coherent accumulation algorithm and dynamic doppler shift compensation, high-gain line spectrum detection of moving targets is achieved.

articleTitle: An infrared video image system design based on CameraLink
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In order to address the limitations of the CameraLink interface infrared detector on the FPGA side, it was proposed that a wider clock frequency CameraLink decoding read-write display system be implemented. This would help to overcome the challenges posed by factors such as FPGA decoding clock frequency exceeding the generated clock jitter, line field signal instability, signal attenuation, and reflection. The hardware employs a decoding chip to complete the digital video image serial-to-parallel conversion of the CameraLink interface, subsequently outputting the LVCMOS signal. The software utilizes Xilinx IP and custom IP, in conjunction with an AXI4 bus interface, to implement FPGA control logic. Test results substantiate the feasibility of the design, demonstrating that the interface system is in accordance with the provisions of the AXI4 bus protocol, exhibiting high flexibility and application value.

articleTitle: Decentralized Operator Screening Scheme for Near-Data Processing Models Based on Precedence Relationships
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of data transmission bottlenecks in traditional database management systems when handling large-scale data. It proposes a filtering scheme for operators under the near-data processing model, based on precedence relations. This scheme conducts an in-depth analysis of the precedence relations in the execution sequence of database operators to identify which ones are more suitable for delegation to intelligent storage devices, thereby reducing unnecessary data migration. The research indicates that this strategy can effectively prevent reverse data transmission and significantly reduce the volume of data transmitted on the bus. This results in a substantial improvement in system processing efficiency and a reduction in energy consumption.
