Experimental verification demonstrates that the filtering scheme based on precedence relations is significantly superior to the traditional filtering method that relies solely on the ratio of input/output data volume. This provides strong support for the development of more efficient database management systems.

articleTitle: The Denoising Method for MEMS Acceleration Signals Based on CEEMDAN-ASA
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To address the susceptibility of MEMS inertial sensor acceleration signals to noise and vibration in rail track monitoring, a denoising method is proposed. First, the Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) is employed to decompose the acceleration signals. Trend Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs) are then identified and removed using correlation coefficients. The remaining IMFs are further refined by iteratively optimizing denoising thresholds through the Adaptive Simulated Annealing (ASA) algorithm. Finally, the selected components are reconstructed. Experimental results show that this method significantly outperforms traditional denoising approaches in terms of mean square error and signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Unequal Error Protection Transmission Based on Error Re-estimation Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In order to realize the high-quality transmission in the Power Line Communication (PLC) system, this paper delves into the application of unequal error protection (UEP) technology leveraging polar codes. By estimating the true reliability of information bits of polar codes, we implement unequal error protection coding within polar code frames, providing differentiated protection for data of varying importance during the PLC transmission. This approach enhances the overall robustness and performance of the PLC system. As a result, the proposed method significantly improves the fidelity of transmitted data, achieving a significant increase in the Bit Error Rate (BER) compared to traditional equal error protection methods.

articleTitle: Parallel Coupling Bandpass Filtering Power Divider Based on Integrated Substrate Gap Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: A parallel coupled bandpass filter power divider (FPD) based on integrated substrate gap waveguide (ISGW) is designed. The overall circuit of the FPD is cascaded by T-type power divider and parallel coupled resonant filter circuit. The parallel circuit design is convenient to adjust the filter characteristics and power characteristics of FPD. The results show that its center frequency is 26.5GHz and its passband is 26.1GHz to 27.1GHz, with good out-of-band suppression on both sides of the passband. The return loss in the passband is less than -25dB, there are 2 transmission zero on the right side, the insertion loss is -1.2dB, and the isolation less than -21dB.

articleTitle: The Research on an Online Review Sentiment Analysis Model Based on Improved RoBERTa
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of internet technologies, platforms such as social media and e-commerce have deeply integrated into daily life, becoming indispensable channels for information exchange and opinion expression. Conducting in-depth sentiment analysis on the vast amount of online review data in a reasonable and effective manner not only allows for the accurate capture of public sentiment and trends in public opinion but also provides valuable insights for policymakers, aiding in informed decision-making. This approach helps to address practical issues in areas such as public opinion guidance and policy optimization. In response to the limitations of traditional sentiment classification models, which struggle with polysemy and inadequate feature extraction capabilities, this paper proposes an optimized sentiment analysis model based on the RoBERTa model. The proposed model integrates a pre-trained model with Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (BiGRU) and Attention (RoBERTa+BiGRU+Attention). The model achieves an accuracy of 95.36% on the IMDB dataset, and experimental results demonstrate that it can better capture and analyze the sentiment within review texts.

articleTitle: Big Data-Driven Intelligent Structure of Two-ticket System for Safety Production in Power Grid Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: As power systems become more intelligent, the intelligent structure of two-ticket system in power grids is key to improving efficiency and safety. This paper investigates the integration of edge computing, artificial intelligence, IoT, and big data into a three-layer system: data collection, edge computing, and central management. Each layer enhances real-time performance, reliability, and intelligence. The system reduces latency through local processing and optimizes decision-making at the central level. Application scenarios demonstrate its practicality and potential for improving power grid operations.

articleTitle: Research on Effective Intergrated Circuit Layout Optimization for Edge Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The layout of integrated circuits not only has a significant impact on the scalability of the interconnect, the reliability of the chip, the power consumption and delay and other performance indicators, but also has a decisive influence on the subsequent wiring design. First, a diagram-based algorithm is used to preliminarily model the wire mesh of the circuit to determine the possible routing paths. Then, the Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) model is used to optimize the prediction of the wiring and component placement of the wire network, and the model learns the best decision according to the local and global layout features. Subsequently, combined with power consumption analysis, the hot spots in the circuit were optimized through the energy-aware clustering method to reduce the overall energy consumption. Finally, the latency and area of the results are evaluated after the layout is completed. Experimental analysis verifies that the proposed method can reduce the layout area and optimize the power consumption while ensuring the performance.

articleTitle: Large Bistatic Angle Spaceborne Radar Beam Synchronous Strategy by Attitude Maneuver for Non-Along-Track observation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Spaceborne bistatic radar has attracted wide attention in the military field due to its superior anti-interference and anti-reconnaissance capabilities. However, with the increasing complexity of the environment, the capabilities of traditional bistatic radars in fast beam coverage and anti-stealth are difficult to meet actual needs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a spaceborne radar beam synchronous strategy by attitude maneuver for non-along-track observation in large bistatic angle geometry. First, it describes the geometric model of the spaceborne bistatic radar, and proposes a solution using the Canny algorithm for imaging edge extraction in complex shaped target areas. Then, an optimal beam footprint arrangement criterion is proposed to maximize echo receiving energy. Through simulation verification, the results show that the proposed method effectively improves the radar's fast beam coverage capability and achieves the optimal beam coverage.

articleTitle: Real-time Obstacle Avoidance and Automatic Power Line Capture Control for De-icing UAVs
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this study, we address the issues of real-time obstacle avoidance path planning and trajectory tracking control for de-icing UAVs during autonomous flight, focusing on obstacle avoidance and automatic power line capture at cruising speeds. First, a real-time obstacle avoidance path planning algorithm based on collision avoidance forces is proposed, integrated with an automatic power line capture system to accurately locate the position of the wires, ensuring precise execution of flight and operational tasks by the UAV. The problem of trajectory time allocation and the numerical solution of the trajectory using the quasi-Newton method are analyzed to optimize path planning. To achieve precise tracking of the real-time obstacle avoidance trajectory and automatic power line capture, a hybrid position control algorithm and attitude control algorithm based on the L1 distance and TECS (Total Energy Control System) are developed. Finally, an online obstacle avoidance and power line capture simulation framework based on PX4 SITL (Software-in-the-Loop) is designed, and software-in-the-loop simulation experiments are conducted. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the designed online obstacle avoidance path planning and power line capture algorithms, as well as the feasibility of the trajectory tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: Near-field Three-dimensional Imaging of Large MIMO Arrays Based on Spatial Phase Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The growing interest in active millimeter-wave and microwave imaging systems is driven by their applications in security, healthcare, and industrial fields. However, imaging systems using single antenna arrays suffer from low efficiency, and Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) radar imaging systems often lack far-field conditions at short distances. In this paper, we propose a novel MIMO near-field imaging algorithm specifically designed for large millimeter-wave radar systems. By employing a linear approximation to compensate for the spatial quadratic phase at a single reference point, the algorithm enables the application of FFT-based imaging techniques within a defined range. The paper details the imaging range applicable to a single reference point, as well as the calculation method and imaging steps for multiple reference points in global imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively focuses target energy, enabling real-time 3D near-field imaging for real aperture arrays.

articleTitle: Robust Direction-of-Arrival Estimation Based on Cascaded Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a cascaded deep neural network framework specifically designed to tackle the challenges of Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation in environments characterized by antenna array imperfections (channel amplitude/phase errors) and low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The framework comprises two primary modules: Firstly, the Covariance Reconstruction Module, which utilizes a Convolutional Autoencoder (CoAE) network to reconstruct sample covariance, effectively mitigating the interference induced by array imperfections. Secondly, the DOA Estimation Module, leveraging a two-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), takes the output from the CoAE network as its input. This module harnesses the robust nonlinear mapping capabilities of the CNN to achieve high-precision DOA estimation under low SNR conditions within a multi-label classification framework. Simulation results indicate that the proposed model significantly reduces DOA estimation errors and demonstrates notable improvements in performance and robustness compared to methods in the literature.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of UAVs with Actor-Critic and Artificial Potential Field
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: UAV technology is developing rapidly and is widely used in various fields. However, achieving efficient control in complex dynamic environments remains a major challenge. To this end, this paper proposes a UAV model predictive control (MPC) method that combines an actor-critic algorithm with an artificial potential field. The method enhances the UAV's environment sensing and path planning capabilities by combining the artificial potential field. By combining the short-term prediction optimisation of the MPC with the exploratory and end-to-end training capabilities of the Actor-Critic algorithm, the proposed method efficiently manages short-term strategies through the Actor network-based MPC and long-term predictions against the Critic network. This approach unifies the advantages of artificial potential fields, model-based MPC and model-free Actor-Critic algorithms. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs well in path planning and forecast tracking in dynamic multi-obstacle environments.

articleTitle: Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper, we explore Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL), focusing on the recognition of new attribute-object combinations using existing concepts. Instead of relying on hand-engineered prompts, recent works learn soft prompts for vision language model (CLIP) using the training data. While the learning procedure is parameter-efficient, it is no enough to reduce the distribute difference between training set and test set in CZSL tasks. Meanwhile, the model needs to focus more on the detailed attribute information and the key object within the image. We propose to tuning the learnable parameters of the model in test time, in order to adapt model to test dataset images. Specifically, We perform multi-view augmentation on the test images, and then obtain multiple prediction probability distributions. By using selection filter and minimize the entropy of probability distribution, we can optimise the learnable prompt of the model and perform adaptive learning during the test phase. Extensive experiments on three widely-used dataset and performance improvement on two state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the effectiveness of our plug-and-play approach.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of design platform for Project feature definition in H5 system based on domain model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, H5 mobile application (App) has become an indispensable part of People's Daily life. However, current technology relies on developers to write code directly to define project features, but it is prone to errors because they often cannot understand the business requirements less than business analytics designers. In addition, test validation must be performed after the code is packaged and published, resulting in inefficient development. What's more, the business object model is closely bound to the technical architecture, making it difficult to reuse the model, which leads to repeated development of similar features in different projects and generates a large amount of redundant code. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a generation method based on domain model. This method defines the project features by business analysts through domain model modeling, and can be verified in the design mode. Finally, H5 application engineering can be generated through code to simplify the development process and improve the development efficiency.

articleTitle: An improved method for extracting the characteristics of ship radiation noise
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an intrinsic modal function (IMF) screening and reconstruction method based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) and singular spectral entropy, in which the IMF obtained by VMD is screened by information entropy calculation, the high-energy background noise is removed from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) signals, and the feature information of the signals is retained to improve the SNR of ship radiated noise signals, which can improve the recognition effect of ship targets to some extent. The experimental results show that the IMF reconstructed signal after information entropy screening highlights the original features of the ship’s radiated noise signal, which can effectively improve the detection rate of targets at longer distances. This technique is crucial for directing the study and creation of passive sonar surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Rice Growth Environment Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Rice is an important grain crop in China, and its yield is greatly affected by the growth environment and pest infestations. This article develops a new type of rice growth environment monitoring system based on Niagara IoT technology, including environmental monitoring of seedling greenhouses and rice fields, as well as image recognition of pest infestations. By deploying Zigbee sensor nodes in greenhouses and rice fields, real-time environmental data is collected, while intelligent inspection drones are used for image acquisition, and YOLOV8 image recognition technology is used for disease and pest detection. The data is transmitted to the control center through the network for analysis and processing, in order to make timely decisions, optimize the growth conditions of rice, improve yield and quality, save resources, reduce environmental impact, and promote the standardization and digitization process of farm management and planting.

articleTitle: A Ka-band combined design high-precision calibration system for high-throughput satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the development of broadband access demand, Ka-band multi-aperture multi-beam antenna is due to its high gain and high C/I ratio widely studied and applied. In order to ensure the pointing accuracy of antenna, monopulse measurement and closed-loop tracking system are usually used to calibrate. In order to optimize the system, this paper proposes a high-precision calibration system which is combined design with antenna and transponder for Ka-band multi-aperture multi-beam high- throughput satellite, the system uses a broadband feed to achieve user, feed and calibration functions, and does not require additional calibration feeds. In addition, the co-redundancy ring design with the low noise amplifier in the transponder improves system reliability and saves 2200g weight for the four-aperture multi-beam antenna satellite. The system has been applied to a high- throughput satellite. After in-orbit test, the antenna pointing accuracy is better than 0.08° after one calibration, and better than 0.06° after multiple calibration.

articleTitle: Intelligent Concert Light Stick Control System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This research outlines the design and implementation of an IoT WiFi-based smart light stick control system. It deploys WLAN for full-venue coverage, enabling automatic network access for every audience’s light stick, which then establishes communication with the control center based on seat numbers. At the control center, light sticks function as pixels on a dynamic display. Operators draw on a touchscreen, and the system maps these pixels, compiles color data, and transmits it via WiFi to receivers, controlling light sticks' illumination and colors in real-time. The system utilizes Arduino microcontroller for pixel counting, ESP8266 wireless module and WebSockets library function for network connection and communication. Upon receiving data, receiver microcontrollers match their positions to execute precise lighting. Preliminary tests confirm the system’s accuracy in pixel tracking and response to control commands, displaying targeted colors effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Software Radio Signal Processing Technology Based on FPGA for OpenWifi
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To enhance the real-time performance and efficiency of radio signal processing, this paper takes OpenWifi as an example to explore the application of FPGA technology in communication systems. By implementing key signal processing functions such as signal demodulation, encoding, and filtering, the results show that FPGA's low latency and high configurability significantly improve processing performance. Additionally, optimized resource allocation and algorithm adjustments further enhance system data throughput and stability, demonstrating the potential of FPGA technology in modern wireless communication.

articleTitle: Mixed Signal Modulation Classification Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aiming at the modulation classification of mixed signals, a modulation classification method based on Deep Learning (DL) is proposed in this paper. First, the baseband complex time-domain signal is split into two parts, the real part and the imaginary part, through In-phase and Quadrature (I&Q) modulation to form the input of the DL network. Subsequently, the design and optimization of the structural parameters of the deep convolutional neural network. Finally, accurate modulation classification of two-component signals is achieved by a multi-class loss function. The simulation results show that compared with other two DL-based two-component modulation classification methods, the detection performance of this method is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Car Control System Based on Android System and Raspberry Pie
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Intelligent car is a kind of wheeled robot, which has high research and application value because of its small size, full functions and wide application. Combining Android mobile phone, mobile robot and remote control technology, this paper designs an intelligent car control system based on Android system and raspberry pie. Firstly, the intelligent car system based on the raspberry pie as the main board not only has the most basic mobile function, but also has designed and completed the functions of ultrasonic ranging automatic obstacle avoidance, steering gear pan/tilt rotation and video capture (its video capture function is realized by downloading and configuring OpenCV software on the raspberry pie, and then using OpenCV software). In addition, in the software design, Python programming is used to control all hardware modules, and the control instructions sent by Android App are received through WiFi, so as to realize the movement of smart car, the rotation of steering gear and the video data transmission. After performance test, the functions of intelligent car movement, ultrasonic ranging and obstacle avoidance, steering gear rotation and video acquisition have been realized.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of Chirp signal detection based on FRFT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Fractional Fourier transform (FRFT), as a generalised form of traditional Fourier transform, can well analyse the local characteristics of signals in the time-frequency plane, and is widely used in various fields such as optics, communications, radar and image processing, etc. Chirp signals, as a kind of typical time-varying signals, are of theoretical significance and practical value in the research of various fields. Therefore, this paper designs and implements a FRFT-based Chirp signal detection system with phase difference and DFRFT algorithms as the core, and optimises the FFT processor, singular point IFFT algorithm and complex matrix multiplication module of the system to give full play to the advantages of the FRFT algorithm for Chirp signal processing. In this paper, the functionality of the Chirp signal detection system is tested at the board level and evaluated in terms of resource consumption and performance. Finally, several sets of experimental data are compared with software simulation to confirm the feasibility and correctness of the scheme. Compared with the traditional two-dimensional search method, the signal detection speed of this design is improved by nearly 10 times, which has some practical value.

articleTitle: A 0.1-1 GHz N-path Bandpass Filter with High In-band Linearity
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: A design methodology of high-order N-path active filter with high in-band linearity is introduced. Based on 130 nm CMOS SOI process, a tunable 6th-order differential N-path bandpass filter of 100-1000 MHz is designed, the feature is that it has a higher in-band input 1 dB compression point, which can be used in the application of higher power requirements. The main structure is based on the N-path filter and coupling of transconductance amplifier equivalent gyrators to achieve a flat passband shape and high linearity, and the passband shape is improved by using Miller compensation method. According to the results of the layout post-simulation, at the center frequency of 500 MHz, the filter’s amplitude of the passband S21 is -0.3 dB, the noise factor is 7.4 dB, the in-band input P1dB is 6.8 dBm, the bandwidth is 14.7 MHz, and the out-of-band suppression is 49 dB at 420 MHz.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the High-performance YOLO Accelerator based on Zynq FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: YOLO object detection algorithm plays a key role in many application fields. FPGA is suitable for small batch streaming applications with strict power consumption constraints. The current hardware acceleration research generally has insufficient computing power and high difficulty in flexible deployment. This paper is devoted to the design of high-performance and lightweight hardware acceleration system by using software and hardware co-design method. High level synthesis technology is used to design the FPGA hardware to realize the modularization of the operation layer, 16-bit dynamic quantization is used to reduce the size of the model. Convolution expansion and block optimization are exploited to design highly reusable and fluid acceleration circuit, pipeline optimization and multi-channel transmission are used to further reduce the inference delay. In summary, this work implements the accelerators for YOLOv2, YOLOv2-tiny and Improving YOLO three models on ZYNQ FPGA platform. For the accelerator of Improving YOLO, the power consumption is 1.917W, the energy efficiency ratio is 6.23GOP/s/W, and gigabit operations per second is 11.96GOP/s. Comparing with similar works, our work achieves better performance.

articleTitle: Substation Ethernet link access control based on TLSec protocol and SM2 certificate
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The automation and control system of substation has extremely high requirements for the security of communication, and any high-threat access may lead to the substation request response is not timely, affecting the stable operation of the power system. Therefore, a method of substation Ethernet link access control based on TLSec protocol and SM2 certificate is proposed. SM2 cryptographic algorithm is used to design the encryption and decryption process of substation Ethernet link. On top of that, SM2 certificates are used for authentication using the TLS protocol. Finally, the algorithm of substation Ethernet link access control is designed by using the private key and public key of the generated network data. The experimental results show that the safety factor of substation Ethernet is higher, the information loss rate is lower, and the recall rate and accuracy rate can reach more than 95%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a W-band Continuous Wave Cloud Radar and Its User-control Software
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Clouds, with a global average occurrence rate exceeding 60%, represent one of the greatest sources of uncertainty regarding future climate change. Millimeter-wave radar can detect characteristic information about particles within clouds, thereby enhancing our understanding of clouds' role in the Earth’s atmosphere. Compared to the Ka-band, the W-band offers higher sensitivity, enabling the detection of a wider range of cloud types. This article presents a scanning-capable W-band continuous wave cloud radar. Additionally, it introduces a supporting user-control software designed to automatically configure radar components for various detection modes, ensuring intelligent and long-term operation of the cloud radar.

articleTitle: Research on IGBT Lifespan Prediction Method Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In recent years, as a critical component in high-voltage and high-power converters, the reliability of IGBT modules has garnered significant attention. In practical applications, IGBTs often operate under extreme conditions, leading to fatigue accumulation, damage, and aging of the power modules, which can result in unplanned system downtime. Predicting the lifespan of IGBTs can help mitigate economic losses. Relevant studies have shown that the lifespan of IGBTs is closely related to junction temperature. Therefore, this paper employs an LSTM algorithm based on RNN to predict the lifespan of IGBT modules. Experimental results demonstrate that this model provides a more accurate prediction of IGBT module lifespan.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Convolutional Neural Networks for Improving Classification Performance of Categories in Quadrature Amplitude Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Due to the increasingly widespread use of composite modulation signals in current communication applications, it is necessary to select the most suitable demodulation method for this type of composite modulation signal based on its specific type. However, traditional methods have low accuracy in classifying a variety of composite modulation signals. This article proposes a scheme based on deep learning to assist signal classification tasks, hoping to improve the accuracy of constellation classification and reduce the difficulty of selecting modulation methods for different signals through this approach. More specifically, this article uses classical neural network models to explore the accuracy of different models in constellation classification tasks, and focuses on the best performing model, MobileNet, to investigate the impact of different image resolutions on the final results under this model. This article utilizes basic communication knowledge to generate a large number of Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) constellation diagrams of different types and signal-to-noise ratios and uses these images to train and learn classical neural network models. The final results indicate that Mobilenet with size of 128×128 performs the best in handling constellation classification tasks and can provide reference value for more complex classification scenarios in the future.

articleTitle: Power Spectrum Estimation of Turbulent Meteorological Signals Based on the autoregressive Model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper explores various spectral estimation methods used in Doppler radar signal processing, specifically for turbulent meteorological signals. The study compares the traditional periodogram method, Pulse Pair Processing (PPP) method, and two autoregressive (AR) models: Yule-Walker and Burg methods. These methods are evaluated based on their ability to estimate Doppler velocity and spectral width under different signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and sampling points. Simulation results show that the AR-Yule-Walker method provides the most accurate and robust performance, especially under low SNR conditions. The Burg method, while effective, shows higher estimation errors in spectral width compared to Yule-Walker. This research highlights the importance of selecting appropriate estimation methods to enhance the accuracy of meteorological observations, particularly when data availability is limited or under noisy conditions. The findings contribute to improving Doppler radar applications in meteorology, such as wind field measurement and weather forecasting.

articleTitle: RID ship imaging method based on OMFrS-WVD
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) is a complex task to image the large-angle motion of a moving ship in a high-resolution radar system. When the sea state is in high sea conditions, the ship target sailing on the sea surface has not only the translational motion along the trajectory direction, but also the three-dimensional rotational motion. Under the influence of this high-dimensional coupled complex motion, the high-order across-range cell migration caused by the ship’s movement is more severe compared to stationary targets. ISAR imaging faces the challenges of echo high-order across-range cell migration and Doppler phase strong spatial variation, which lead to defocused images. In response to this issue, this paper proposes an OMFrS-WVD-based RID ship imaging method. By employing the proposed OMFrS-WVD time-frequency analysis processing method instead of the Fourier transform to achieve azimuthal focusing, high-resolution refocused imaging of ship targets under severe sea conditions is realized. This method avoids cross-term interference and effectively breaks through the limitations of time-frequency resolution. Theoretical analysis and simulation experimental results validate the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Weak signal detection method for space-based ESM based on fractional domain matched filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the development of information warfare, space-based electronic reconnaissance system plays an increasingly important role in battlefield situation awareness. As one of the cores of space-based electronic reconnaissance, weak signal detection technology directly affects the effectiveness of reconnaissance system. This article proposes a weak signal detection method for space-based ESM based on fractional domain matched filtering.Through the rotation characteristics of fractional Fourier transform in time-frequency domain, combined with the optimal SNR characteristics of matched filter, the weak signal submerged in the complex electromagnetic environment can be effectively detected. Through theoretical derivation, simulation experiment and comparative analysis, the superior performance of this method in complex background is verified, which provides a new way for signal processing of space-based electronic reconnaissance.

Author Keywords: fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) matched filtering space-based electronic reconnaissance electronic weak signal detection

articleTitle: Sum and Difference Beams Synthesis for a Sparse Array with a Common Excitation Vector
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: A method was proposed for generating sum and difference beam patterns simultaneously in a sparse antenna array by utilizing a common excitation vector. This approach was motivated by the challenges in accurately estimating signal arrival direction and the intricate design of feeding network structures. This study formulates a nonconvex optimization problem based on the radiation performance of dual beams, incorporating a nonconvex mainlobe constraint for the sum beam and a nonconvex null depth constraint for the difference beam. The successive convex approximation algorithm is utilized to address these formulated problems. In order to overcome infeasible solutions arising from nonconvex constraints, slack variables are introduced to aid in the pursuit of feasible points. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm improves the radiation performance of both sum and difference beam patterns with fewer antennas compared to other algorithms, thus confirming the advantages of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Partial-Structure Work-Energy Theorem (PS-WET)-Based Characteristic Mode Theory (CMT) for Yagi–Uda Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Partial-structure work-energy theorem (PS-WET) governing the work-energy transformation process of Yagi–Uda array antennas is derived. Partial-structure driving power as the source for sustaining the steady work-energy transformation is formulated in terms of an operator called partial-structure driving power operator (PS-DPO). Using the PS-WET and PSDPO, the essential difference between the working mechanisms of scattering objects and Yagi–Uda array antennas is revealed. The difference exposes that the conventional characteristic mode theory (CMT) for scattering objects cannot be directly applied to Yagi–Uda array antennas. Under the PS-WET framework, this paper proposes a generalized CMT for Yagi–Uda array antennas. By diagonalizing the PS-DPO, the PS-WET-based CMT (PS-WET-CMT) can construct a set of energy-decoupled characteristic modes (CMs) for an objective Yagi–Uda array antenna, and then can provide an effective modal analysis for the antenna. The various orthogonality relationships and the Parseval’s theorem satisfied by the CMs are rigorously proved and physically explained. The physical meanings of the characteristic values and modal significances (MSs) associated to the CMs are also obtained by using the PS-WET-based modal decomposition. Some typical numerical experiments are demonstrated for verifying the validity of the PS-WET-CMT proposed in this paper. In addition, an example using a series of scattering CMs to expand the dominant transmitting CM (for metallic Yagi–Uda structure) is also exhibited.

articleTitle: 3D Human Pose Estimation with Bone Symmetry and Motion Locality
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The bone symmetry and motion locality are two important priors for 3D human pose estimation. For bone symmetry, symmetric bones typically have equal length and higher motion correlation. In terms of motion locality, the motion of the human body conforms to its structure and is temporally continuous. These two priors align with human intuition, but are challenging for Transformer to directly abstract them from data. We propose novel modules, Bone Symmetry Temporal Transformer (BSTT) and Spatial-Temporal Locality Fusion (STLF), to utilize these two priors, and design a new Transformer-based BSMLFormer model. Specifically, BSTT considers the temporal sequences of two symmetric bones as a single new sequence and calculates its global relationships by self-attention mechanism. STLF performs local computations by GCN and convolutions to capture the local dependencies in adjacent joints and adjacent parts. The local-global alternating structure of BSMLFormer allows for consideration of the local information during global calculations. More remarkably, BSMLFormer achieves the state-of-the-art performance with 39.0mm MPJPE on Human3.6M dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Modulation Scheme for Low Earth Orbit Satellite Navigation Augmentation Signals Based on the L-Band
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: L-band dual-frequency broadcasting offers significant advantages in navigation augmentation, effectively reducing ionospheric errors, improving positioning accuracy, and enhancing system anti-interference capabilities. Currently, dual-frequency broadcasting predominantly uses CBOC modulation. However, CBOC's complex signal structure complicates receiver design, and its multipath resistance is limited in environments with strong multipath effects, such as urban canyons, where it is susceptible to interference from reflected signals, leading to reduced code tracking accuracy. Moreover, CBOC's large phase transitions increase the difficulty of phase tracking in the receiver, impacting the stability of signal acquisition and tracking. In response, this paper proposes an L-band dual-frequency broadcasting scheme based on BM1REC(2)h9.5. Compared to CBOC(6,1,1/11), this scheme maintains excellent compatibility while offering better code tracking accuracy and improved multipath resistance, contributing to further enhancements in LEO-based navigation augmentation system performance.

articleTitle: Precise Floating-Point Summation and Dot Product Computation for Sunway
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The Sunway platform, as a representative of domestic high-performance processors, is widely used in scientific computing, but it has certain limitations in hardware support for floating-point operations, especially in high-precision calculations. To address this issue, the cumulative effect of rounding errors in floating-point addition and dot product operations was explored. Subsequently, based on the error-free transformation technique and the SIMD instructions and floating-point vector registers on the Sunway1621 platform, the floating-point summing SimdSum algorithm and the dot product SimdDot algorithm were designed and implemented. On the test set generated by GenDot2, the relative error of the computation results of the SimdDot algorithm compared to double-precision results was reduced by an average of 99.9%, demonstrating better stability and the ability to adapt to a larger range of condition numbers. On the test data set generated by the Sin function, the computational accuracy of the SimdSum algorithm reached the level of computational accuracy of the long double type on the Intel platform. When comparing the proposed algorithms with double-precision operations on the Sunway1621 processor, on different scales of test sets randomly generated in Python, although the average running time of the SimdSum and SimdDot algorithms was about 13.06 times that of double precision, the precision of the computational results was significantly improved.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Lightweight Intrusive Traffic Detection Method Based on Deep Learning under Evolving Network Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In the complicated modern network, an effective intrusive traffic detection (ITD) scheme is paramount for enhancing the cybersecurity. Due to the continuous dynamics of data and the introduction of new classes, the existing ITD methods based on deep learning primarily reliant on joint training face challenges. And the frequent retraining is in the price of real-time responsiveness and computational resource. Moreover, the incremental learning strategy is dependent on exemplar sets heavily, which results in a significant storage cost for retaining old-class exemplars. Hence, the ITD problem under evolving network threats should be resolved. In this paper, we propose an adaptive and lightweight ITD method within a class incremental learning (ALCIL) framework. In the proposed ALCIL framework, the attention mechanism and prototype extraction technique are combined to guarantee precise and efficient feature extraction from new threats, as well as reducing the storagerequirement significantly. The design of our framework aims to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, thereby ensuring that the system retains knowledge of earlier classes as it integrates new ones.

articleTitle: Over the Air Based Distributed Beamforming Design for RIS Aided Cell-Free MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The integration of reconfigurable intelligent surface(RIS) and Cell-Free multiple-input multiple-output (CFMIMO) has the potential to become a new trend in 6G. This paper studies the weighted sum-rate(WSR) maximization problem in RIS-aided CF-MIMO networks. We first convert the non-convex WSR maximization into weighted sum-mean square error(MSE) minimization. To decentralize the problem, we utilize the alternating optimization to design the suboptimal beamforming with the goal of weighted sum-MSE minimization. To reduce the signaling overheads related to acquiring the necessary correlation information among APs for designing active beamforming at each AP locally, we introduce a special over-the-air signaling combination scheme. Facing the constraint of discrete phase shifts of RIS, we deploy the proximal gradient descent to optimize the passive beamforming. Simulation results indicate that our proposed scheme achieves lower complexity and higher scalability, approaching the WSR of centralized and distributed-backhaul methods, while outperforming the non-collaborative Local-MMSE method.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Measurement Method of Aircraft Pose Parameters Based on Prior 3D Model Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To address the dynamic measurement requirements of aircraft pose parameters during near-field and takeoff-landing processes, we propose a visual measurement method based on prior 3D model matching. This method utilizes an intelligent electro-optical tracking measurement system equipped with multiband variable-focus imaging components to achieve extensive target tracking and imaging under complex weather conditions throughout the day. The system’s parallel computing and control platform receives a sequence of target images, employing a relative pose estimation algorithm based on the uncertainty of spatial reference points to obtain the initial pose parameters of the aircraft. Subsequently, it integrates an existing 3D CAD model of the aircraft for spatial online projection registration. This process iteratively optimizes conditions to minimize segmentation loss and dense feature matching loss, yielding optimal measurements of the aircraft’s pose. Experimental validation using actual C919 flight data demonstrates that the proposed method achieves a position measurement RMS error of better than 1.2m and an attitude measurement RMS error of better than 0.5°.

articleTitle: Voice dialog system based on RWKV model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper aims to develop an intelligent voice interaction dialogue system for the aging Chinese society, focusing on meeting the needs of the elderly in home-based care. The system is designed with speech recognition, language model, and speech synthesis, using a large-scale language model called RWKV. To address the disadvantage that existing dialogue systems cannot make effective responses for the elderly, this paper is based on the corpus of the elderly and combines the RWKV model, which is fine-tuned by Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) technology to generate natural language responses. The experimental results show that the system partially improves the fluency and reasonableness of the answers when dealing with the daily problems of the elderly, and that the intelligent dialogue system based on the RWKV model has a great potential to be applied in the elder's home-based community care, which can improve the accuracy and naturalness of the answers, and will reduce the operation cost to a certain extent. In addition to this, this paper provides a comparison of loss function curves for some of the initial and final learning rates. Finally, future work will further optimise the model to improve its adaptability and fluency in different application scenarios.

articleTitle: Improvement Strategies for Mask R-CNN in Satellite Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the development of mega-constellations and space technology, the frequency and number of satellite anomalies in orbit are increasing in tandem, and the demand for autonomous in-orbit repair operations is becoming increasingly urgent. Autonomous repair technology is limited by the efficiency and accuracy of identifying and operating on repair targets (such as malfunctioning parts and capture components) in orbit, and it is not yet capable of supporting in-orbit application implementation. To address this issue, this paper proposes a satellite component recognition method based on an improved MASK R-CNN model, which introduces a new network structure, CB-Resnet, and integrates the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to achieve precise fault part recognition and localization. The CB-Resnet module enhances the model's ability to express key component features in images, while the PSO algorithm optimizes network parameters, improving the model's global search capability and generalization performance. With this method, repair spacecraft can quickly identify operational components, thereby supporting the formulation of rapid fault handling plans, improving repair efficiency, and reducing operational difficulty. Experimental results show that the improved model performs excellently in component recognition tasks, providing an effective technical support for the development of autonomous in-orbit satellite repair operations.

articleTitle: PPO Improvement in Different Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This study investigates strategies to improve the performance of the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm in different environments. The PPO algorithm is a widely used method in reinforcement learning, known for its robustness and efficiency in various tasks. However, its performance can vary significantly depending on the environment, and there is a continuous need for optimization to enhance its learning capabilities and overall effectiveness. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate whether specific strategies i.e. adaptive learning rate, neural network initialization, state normalization, and reward clipping can lead to better learning and eventually better overall performance of the PPO algorithm. Three distinct environments are utilized for the evaluation i.e. robotic control environments from OpenAI Gym (HalfCheetah, Walker2D) and a Futures Trading environment. Our results demonstrate that the proposed strategies lead to a PPO variant that significantly outperforms the baseline PPO in all the studied environments. These findings underscore the potential of the improved PPO performance for more effective reinforcement learning applications.

articleTitle: Energy Functionals and Variational Principle in Electromagnetic Modal Analysis—Part V: Re-exploring Magneto-Dielectric CMA
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: An important theoretical question—how to formulate a physically reasonable characteristic mode (CM)generating operator—on the characteristic mode analysis (CMA) for magneto-dielectric scatterers is re-explored, and the corresponding conclusion obtained previously is further reconfirmed by using some new methods different from the previous methods. The new methods are based on variational principle, work-energy theorem, and reciprocity theorem, and the new methods lead to the same conclusion as the one obtained previously. The conclusion is that: the CM-generating operator for magneto-dielectric scatterers should be formulated as the complex driving power done by the externally incident field on the scattered currents; during the process to formulate the CM-generating operator, the complex conjugate operations should act on the scattered currents (if do not act on the incident fields), or act on the incident fields (if do not act on the scattered currents).

articleTitle: Analysis of virtual coupling control parameters based on colored Petri net
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In the rail transit system, improving transportation efficiency is an eternal topic. Therefore, in this paper a novel approach in train control systems based on the concept called virtual coupling or train convoys. And the virtual coupling scheme is described in this paper. The dynamic model of the virtual coupling and the Petri net model of the control process are established. In order to analyze the influence of each parameter on the minimum tracking distance, the minimum tracking distance is determined, which provides reference and theoretical basis for the design of the control system in the future, and finally the actual subway operation scenario. For example, the tracking distance is calculated under the most unfavorable situation, and the possibility of virtual coupling in the existing subway line is theoretically demonstrated under the premise that the control system meets the requirements.

articleTitle: An Approach for Improving Pure-Inertial Navigation Accuracy by Optimizing the Pre-Integration Window of Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The application of underwater inertial navigation in autonomous underwater vehicle ( AUV ) is very important, but the cumulative error of inertial navigation in complex sea conditions is large, which seriously affects its positioning accuracy. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a deep learning pure inertial navigation method based on preprocessing time window optimization, and focuses on the influence of the length of preprocessing time window on the accuracy of motion calculation. The purpose is to improve the adaptability and robustness of the inertial navigation system in different motion states by optimizing the length of the preprocessing time window. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the researchers conducted sea trials, during which navigation data under different motion modes were collected. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the cumulative error of inertial navigation under complex sea conditions compared with the original method, which verifies the effectiveness and universality of the method, and has the value of popularization and engineering application.

articleTitle: DistilBERT Hotel Rating Prediction Model Based on an Ensemble Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The swift advancements in artificial intelligence and natural language processing have significantly impacted the hospitality industry by enabling more precise sentiment analysis and recommendation systems. This study presents a novel hotel rating prediction model leveraging DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT, within an ensemble learning framework. DistilBERT retains 97% of BERT's performance while being 60% faster and 40% smaller, making it ideal for real-time applications in resource-constrained environments. Our ensemble model combines two DistilBERT models, one processing review titles and the other processing review texts, to capture comprehensive semantic information from both sources. The dataset used comprises approximately 10,000 hotel reviews, preprocessed to ensure quality and consistency. Through rigorous training and evaluation, including the use of cross-validation and random search for hyperparameter tuning, our model demonstrated superior performance compared to traditional machine learning models and other pre-trained language models such as BERT, RoBERTa, and ALBERT. The DistilBERT ensemble model achieved high accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, showcasing its effectiveness in handling complex text classification tasks. This research provides valuable insights for the hospitality industry, enabling better prediction of customer satisfaction and enhancing service quality. Future work could explore additional features, multi-lingual capabilities, and further optimization to improve model performance.

articleTitle: Research on Signaling Attacks and Defenses in 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The 5G mobile communication system has long been an integral component of the new generation of national information infrastructure. While it brings convenience to society, it also poses numerous security challenges. Signaling attacks, as one of the more innovative forms of attack within the 5G system, have been infrequently subjected to in-depth analysis and summarization in the literature. This paper analyzes the security issues present in the 5G network architecture from the perspectives of the User Equipment (UE), Radio Access Network (RAN), and 5G Core (5GC). It provides a summary and categorization of identified signaling attacks, outlines countermeasures for signaling defenses, and discusses the challenges faced. Furthermore, the paper looks forward to the future of the relevant technologies to promote the research on signaling attacks and defenses in 5G network.

articleTitle: Multi-label code smell Detection Method based on CodeBERT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Code smells usually hint at possible problems or design flaws in the code. Efficient code smell detection methods can significantly improve code quality. However, existing code smell detection methods rely heavily on information such as metrics and indicators, fail to make full use of the syntax and semantics of source code, and have shortcomings in multi-label code smell detection. To this end, this paper proposes a Multi-Label Code Smell Detection Based on CodeBERT (MLCSDCB) based on the pre-trained model CodeBERT. Firstly, the constructed data set is preprocessed and standardized to reduce noise interference, and the multi-label data set is constructed by the label power set method. Then, CodeBERT is used to embed the code and extract its rich syntactic and semantic information. Then, Bi-LSTM was used to fully learn the Code Representation Information [CLS] vector of each layer of CodeBERT to enhance the context understanding ability of the model. Finally, the attention mechanism was used to strengthen the key information according to the importance of each layer [CLS] vector, and the multi-label prediction was performed based on the strengthened feature vector to improve the detection effect of the model. Compared with the existing detection methods based on source code representation, MLCSDCB improves the precision, recall and F1 value by 2.02%, 1.04%and 4.75%respectively.

articleTitle: Entity Extraction Research with Relative Position Encoding and Masked Conditional Random Fields : Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Traditional named entity recognition methods lack relative positional information interaction and pay little attention to the distance information between entities, which makes it difficult to determine the entity boundaries when recognizing entities and affects recognition performance. To address these issues, we propose an entity recognition method that combines relative positional encoding with masked conditional random fields. First, we introduce rotation positional encoding at the encoding layer to enhance the span information between characters, and use a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) to capture contextual representations and a convolutional neural network (CNN) to capture local key information in the text to construct a multi-dimensional feature-rich text representation. Second, in the decoding stage, MaskedCRF is used to legally constrain the label results to make them more in line with the correct label distribution. Finally, a lightweight data augmentation method for fragment entity deletion and replacement is proposed to expand the generalizability of the text enhancement model. The method is based on RoBERTa-BiLSTM-MaskedCRF. The experimental results on the Weibo and Resume datasets show that the F1 reached 72.85% and 96.30% respectively, which is an improvement of 3.80% and 0.62% compared to the baseline model. It has better recognition performance, is simple and convenient to implement, and has good portability. It can provide a way of thinking for subsequent entity recognition research.

articleTitle: E-RL:Vehicle Driving Strategy Learning with Environmental Reinforcement Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To address urban traffic congestion simulation after Traffic Management Initiatives (TMI) implementation, a method combining deep reinforcement learning with environmental optimization is proposed, optimizing the environmental strategy through a fixed agent policy. To tackle the challenges posed by road network topology changes post-TMI, the method designs an environmental Markov reinforcement learning framework and introduces graph neural networks to dynamically calculate road resistance in urban areas. Combined with the Dijkstra algorithm, the vehicle routing strategy is determined. This strategy is then applied to the road network after TMI to predict road resistance post-TMI. Experiments validate that this method achieves good congestion replication in the original road network environment and effectively predicts congestion after TMI implementation.

articleTitle: GNN-Based Semantic Segmentation for Contact Network Insulators
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: With the vigorous development and wide application of electrified railroad in the world, the research of contact network has been gradually deepened. The state of contact network equipment is closely related to the normal operation of trains, and the failure and geometric parameters of components will directly affect the quality and safety of trains. Realizing the automation and intelligent inspection of each link of contact network of high-speed railroad is the development goal of future railroad inspection, and the intelligence of contact network overhaul task is imminent. As the upstream task of intelligent maintenance of contact network components, the component segmentation of contact network is very important. Due to the limited data characterization ability of traditional point cloud segmentation methods, this work proposes HC-SPG, a Superpoint Graph (SPG) algorithm based on the spatial attention mechanism. This work chooses insulators as the segmentation target, and the experimental results show that our algorithm operates well on the contact network dataset, and the Overall Accuracy (OA) improves by 1.04% and the Mean Intersection over Union (MIoU) improves by 5.21% compared with the SPG algorithm.

articleTitle: A weakly supervised back-labeling-based method for named entity recognition in automotive manufacturing: MBIC-NER
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of lack of corpus, lack of entity annotation dataset and fragmented data in named entity recognition in the automobile manufacturing field, a new named entity recognition method is proposed: MBIC-NER. The method firstly constructs an automobile manufacturing annotation dataset by using the idea of weakly supervised back annotation, and generates word vector sequences of the input sentences by using MacBERT pre-training model in order to better understand the context and semantic associations, and improves the accuracy and effect of text processing in the field of automobile manufacturing; Secondly, BiLSTM model and IDCNN model are constructed to perform feature extraction on the input word vector sequences to form a multilevel feature representation; Finally, the character sequences are continued to be decoded through the CRF, and the corresponding label of each character is obtained. The result show that the F1-score of MBIC-NER for named entity recognition in the self-constructed automobile manufacturing domain dataset reaches 87.03%, which is better than the other named entity recognition methods in comparison.

articleTitle: Intelligent Strawberry Ripeness and Disease Detection Classification System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In modern agricultural production, timely detection of crop diseases and accurate assessment of ripeness are crucial for reducing yield loss and enhancing product quality. Strawberries, being a widely popular and economically valuable fruit, are particularly sensitive to diseases and strict in ripeness requirements, making quality control during their production critical. This paper develops a classification system for strawberry ripeness and pest disease detection based on the YOLOv5 deep learning model and automated robotic arm technology. The YOLOv5 model, known for its high efficiency, accurately identifies strawberries and assesses their ripeness and pest conditions, thereby enhancing the precision and speed of detection. The automated robotic arm technology utilizes the detection results from the YOLOv5 model to perform efficient and accurate automated sorting and grading of strawberries, significantly reducing labor costs and human error. By integrating deep learning and automation technologies, this system substantially increases strawberry yield and quality, alleviates labor burdens, and enhances agricultural production efficiency.

articleTitle: Fusion of Contrastive Learning and Heterogeneous Graph for Code Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of existing code summary generation methods in dealing with the semantic complexity, structural diversity of code and the fusion of search summary and generation summary, a code summary generation method combining contrast learning and heterogeneous graph is proposed. Firstly, a dense vector retrieval framework based on double encoders is adopted to enhance the retrieval accuracy and semantic diversity of large-scale code data. Secondly, the abstract syntax tree is reconstructed into a heterogeneous graph. By introducing various node and edge types, the model's ability to capture complex semantic relationships between different node and edge types is deepened. Finally, the copy gate mechanism is introduced to realize the dynamic fusion of retrieval abstracts and generated model output in semantic level, which guarantees the semantic accuracy and relevance of generated abstracts. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness of this approach in improving the precision and relevance of generated code summaries.
